name: ai-native-sdlc
description: AI-native SDLC workflow as a reusable skill: turn any product goal into a planned, built, tested, deployed, and monitored project with human approval gates at every artifact.

interface.shortDescription: Take a tracker task to a reviewed MR/PR with approval gates
interface.longDescription: Encodes Anthropic's AI-Native SDLC playbook as a reusable workflow: take the intent from the tracker, then design, plan, build, and review, with versioned artifacts and human approval gates at every handoff. Give your agent a task link and it drives the work to an opened MR/PR — never merging or deploying.
defaultPrompt: Build my idea as an AI-native SDLC project
Run the AI-native SDLC workflow for this Linear or GitLab task link
Take this feature from spec to an opened MR/PR
